description: A ALPHA GENESIS é uma equipe de cinco integrantes apaixonados por ciência, tecnologia e exploração espacial. Unimos pesquisa, criatividade e inovação para transformar conhecimento em soluções educativas. Acreditamos que cada descoberta começa com uma pergunta e que o conhecimento é o caminho para explorar novos horizontes. Nosso objetivo é desenvolver projetos que inspirem pessoas e contribuam para o futuro da ciência.
summary: THE LAST EXPLORERS is an educational 2D pixel-art exploration game that takes players on missions to the Moon and Mars. Players explore each environment, use tools such as a tracker and flashlight, drive a rover on Mars, and search for historical space exploration equipment. By discovering and cataloging these objects, players learn about real missions and the history of robotic and human exploration beyond Earth. The game transforms space history into an interactive experience, combining exploration, discovery, and learning. Its goal is to make scientific knowledge more engaging and accessible, encouraging curiosity about astronomy, planetary science, and humanity's exploration of the Solar System.
details:
THE LAST EXPLORERS is an educational 2D exploration game designed to introduce players to the history of space exploration through interactive gameplay.

The experience takes place on two destinations: the Moon and Mars. Players explore each environment, use a tracking system to locate hidden sites, and search for historical equipment left behind by past space missions. On the Moon, players use a flashlight and exploration tools. On Mars, they can also operate a rover to travel across a larger map.

When players find a real historical object, they can investigate and catalog it, learning about its mission and significance. The game also includes empty search locations that encourage exploration and make discovery less predictable.

The project's main benefit is educational: it turns information about space missions into an interactive experience. It aims to encourage curiosity about astronomy, planetary science, engineering, and the history of human and robotic exploration.

The game was developed with assistance from Google AI Studio, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Vercel was used to publish the project online. Canva was used to create the presentation.

The creative aspect is the combination of pixel-art gameplay, exploration mechanics, historical discoveries, and educational storytelling. The team focused on creating an accessible experience that connects real space exploration history with an engaging game.
